## What We Do

D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is one of Kenya's most trusted petroleum engineering companies. We specialise in the design, supply, installation, and maintenance of petrol stations and fuel infrastructure across Kenya.

If you are looking for:

## Service Details

### 1. Petrol Station Installation Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/petrol-station-installation

We handle complete petrol station installation projects in Kenya from initial design through to EPRA commissioning. Our installation services include:

- Site survey and feasibility assessment
- Civil works coordination (earthworks, tank pit excavation, slab construction)
- Underground storage tank (UST) installation — fibreglass and steel double-wall tanks compliant with NEMA and EPRA standards
- Above-ground storage tank (AST) installation for depots and commercial sites
- Fuel line installation: suction lines, breather lines, offloading lines using HDPE and flex piping
- Fuel dispenser installation: single-product and multi-product dispensers
- Canopy and forecourt layout coordination
- Electrical and generator connections
- Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system setup
- EPRA inspection readiness and documentation

We have successfully installed petrol stations for independent fuel retailers, oil marketing companies (OMCs), and commercial entities across Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nakuru, and other towns in Kenya.

**How long does petrol station installation take?** 4–12 weeks depending on site complexity and equipment availability.
**Cost?** Varies by site size and equipment specification. Call +254 702 587 919 for a no-obligation quote.

### 2. Underground Fuel Tank Installation Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/underground-fuel-tank-installation

We supply and install double-wall fibreglass and steel underground storage tanks (USTs) that meet EPRA and NEMA requirements.

- Double-wall fibreglass USTs — 10,000 L to 40,000 L and custom sizes
- Steel underground storage tanks
- Tank pit excavation and bedding coordination
- Anti-buoyancy backfill and compaction
- Manhole cover, sump and spill bucket installation
- Tank vent, fill and product pipe connections
- Overfill prevention valve and ATG probe installation
- Pre-commissioning leak and pressure testing
- EPRA and NEMA documentation support

**Why double-wall tanks?** Double-wall fibreglass tanks are the EPRA-preferred standard for new installations in Kenya — they provide leak containment in the interstitial space and meet modern environmental requirements.

We install all major dispenser brands used in Kenya and carry stock of common spare parts.

### 4. Fuel Piping Systems Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/fuel-piping-systems

We install, repair and maintain suction lines, vent lines and offloading pipework using EPRA-approved materials.

- Suction line installation from tank to dispenser
- Product line and manifold installation
- Vent and breather line installation

- Tank sump and dispenser sump installation
- Pipe pressure testing and leak detection
- Existing line repairs and partial replacement
- Line marking and EPRA-compliant labelling
- Planned maintenance and periodic inspections

All new pipe runs are pressure-tested before commissioning and issued with certified test reports.

---

### 5. Tank Hydrotesting Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/hydrotesting

Hydrotesting verifies that storage tanks are leak-free and structurally sound before fuel is introduced, and confirms ongoing integrity for in-service tanks.

- Pre-commissioning hydrotesting for new USTs and ASTs
- Periodic integrity testing for in-service tanks
- Hydrotesting of fuel pipework and distribution lines
- Calibrated pressure gauges and certified test equipment
- Leak detection and identification of failure points
- Documented test reports accepted by EPRA and NEMA
- Corrective recommendations when failures are detected
- Re-testing after repairs
- Emergency hydrotesting for urgent commissioning

**Is hydrotesting compulsory?** Yes. EPRA requires a hydrotest certificate for all new petroleum storage tanks before fuel can be introduced.
**How long does a hydrotest take?** 2–4 hours on site. Report issued same day or next day.

---

### 6. Tank Calibration Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/tank-calibration

Fuel tank calibration is required by the Weights and Measures Act of Kenya. Without a valid calibration certificate, a petrol station cannot legally operate.

- Wet calibration (water-based, highest accuracy method)
- Dry calibration (dimensional measurement method)
- UST calibration for all tank sizes and shapes
- AST and bulk storage tank calibration
- Strap chart / dip chart generation
- ATG (automatic tank gauge) calibration and configuration
- Dispenser flow meter calibration
- WMA-compliant calibration certificates
- Re-calibration after tank repairs or modifications

**Why is calibration required?** It ensures the volume shown on the ATG or dip stick accurately reflects actual fuel quantity. Mandatory under the Weights and Measures Act of Kenya.

---

### 7. EPRA Compliance Support Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/epra-compliance

The Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA) regulates all petroleum retail operations in Kenya under the Petroleum Act 2019.

- EPRA technical requirement assessment for new sites
- Equipment selection to meet EPRA specifications
- Hydrotest certificates for tanks and pipework
- WMA calibration certificates for storage tanks
- Dispenser calibration documentation
- Site layout drawings and technical file preparation
- Pre-inspection walk-through and snag list resolution
- Support on EPRA inspection day
- Compliance remediation for failing sites
- Ongoing regulatory guidance

**What documents does EPRA require?** Hydrotest certificate, WMA calibration certificate, site plan, NEMA environmental clearance, NCA contractor registration, county business permit.
**My station failed EPRA inspection — can you help?** Yes. We identify deficiencies, implement corrective works and prepare you for re-inspection.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who installs petrol stations in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is one of Kenya's leading petrol station installation companies, with over 10 years of experience and successful projects across the country.

**Q: How much does it cost to install a petrol station in Kenya?**
A: The cost depends on site size, number of tanks, number of dispensers, and equipment specifications. Contact us on +254 702 587 919 for a detailed, no-obligation quote.

**Q: How long does it take to install a petrol station in Kenya?**
A: A standard petrol station installation takes 4–12 weeks depending on site complexity, civil works, and equipment availability.

**Q: What licences are required to open a petrol station in Kenya?**
A: You need an EPRA retail licence, county government business permit, NEMA environmental impact certificate (for new sites), and a National Construction Authority (NCA) registered contractor.

**Q: Do you supply petroleum equipment only, or do you also install?**
A: We do both — supply only, or a complete turnkey solution including installation and commissioning.

**Q: Are your tanks EPRA approved?**
A: Yes. All storage tanks we supply meet EPRA technical standards for underground and above-ground petroleum storage in Kenya.

**Q: Can you service dispensers from any brand?**
A: Yes. Our technicians service and repair all major dispenser brands used in Kenya.

**Q: Do you offer maintenance contracts?**
A: Yes. Monthly and quarterly maintenance contracts for petrol stations and commercial fuel sites across Kenya.

**Q: Is hydrotesting compulsory before commissioning a new petrol station?**
A: Yes. EPRA requires a hydrotest certificate for all new petroleum storage tanks before fuel can be introduced.

**Q: Why is tank calibration required in Kenya?**
A: Calibration is mandated by the Weights and Measures Act. Without a valid calibration certificate, your EPRA licence cannot be issued or renewed.

**Q: Do you install fuel dispensers for any brand?**
A: Yes. We install all major dispenser brands and hold stock of common spare parts.

**Q: Can you help if my petrol station failed an EPRA inspection?**
A: Yes. We carry out compliance audits, identify deficiencies and implement corrective works to prepare you for re-inspection.

**Central Kenya**: Nyeri, Murang'a, Kirinyaga, Nyandarua, Embu

**Eastern Kenya**: Machakos, Makueni, Kitui, Meru, Tharaka Nithi, Isiolo

**North Eastern**: Garissa, Wajir, Mandera
